sourceRecognition.comments: Independently viewed source: black combined rack/cable unit, plate storage on left, central weight stack and rods, low front pulley on extended base, bench to right, mirror to left and blinds behind. No trainer or customer in original.

observation.comments: One male customer performs a low-cable curl to the right of the existing combined rack. The visible handle/carabiner/cable leads down to the low front pulley. Front selected stack is raised with remaining plates below, mechanically plausible. Rack, left plate pegs, right bench and rear window remain in corresponding zones; scene changes framing and generated surface detail, not a relocated machine or a new room. Three-quarter crop excludes feet; stance, lower-body perspective and visible machine floor/base contact are plausible within the frame. Exact pixel preservation is not claimed.

visual_art_direction.comments: Golden参照と同じく、墨色の補助句・大きな黄土色の中心語・写真へ溶ける紙色のfadeで階層が成立。wide/OGPは左中央の3行、GBPは独立した狭い3行を左の縦中央へ配置。全320/400px実JPEGで即読でき、右の顔と持ち手がveilに隠れない。GBPの「引っ張る／方向で、動きが／変わる。」は語中や助詞単独で分断されず、意味を追える範囲。文字は小さな上端ラベルではなく人物と釣り合う第二焦点。局所veilの境界は曲線的で直線の白板には見えない。

api_usage.scope: This independent reviewer used Work and local deterministic code only.

comments: 顧客1名の低ケーブルカールは、顔・上腕・手元・低滑車へ向かうワイヤーが一覧でも識別でき、ケーブル記事の行動として具体性がある。顔と手は自然で、灰色シャツの人物に切り抜き縁や不整合な光は見えない。実店舗のラック／ブラインド／ベンチを場所のアンカーとして保ち、背景奥は人物より弱い。近接するラック部材は動作の機械関係を伝えるため比較的鮮明だが、人物の顔・腕・動作が写真の主役として先に読める。足は画角外なので足裏の直接確認は不可。空間の厳密な同一ピクセル性やパフォーマンス効果は主張しない。
limitations: Review is bound to exact local bytes and supplied canonical history; parent must refresh live history and adopt assets through canonical Bridge/production path.
Visual PASS is not public asset byte verification, READY state, Publish preflight or owner Publish approval.
optional_improvements: A future edit could choose 引っ張る方向 as the emphasis if preserving copy and passing all typography gates; current hierarchy remains acceptable and this is not a required repair.
